searchText: Ah thanks for this, this looks like exactly what I needed to bench lighthouse/grandine. How much is the runtime impact of this? I assume I can't run CPU benchmarks at the same time than using these right? It's below 14ns per function call for plain timers and slightly more for tracking allocations/hardware counters https://github.com/gattaca-com/flux/blob/main/crates/flux-profiler/README.md#overhead Thanks so much, this is helpful. I'm hoping to be at a benching stage very soon
